items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Ivy's brother came to me and pointed out a fellow sitting at the bar and said that he had insulted Beezie.

ctx.x: Mr Faletti had allowed us to invite our wives and girl friends to a bar that was in the back of the main dining room. Beezie, Boob, Ivy the girl friend of Charlie Lewis, and Ined the sister of Ivy who was Ollie Tine(s) girl friend and their brother who was about 17. They could hear the music from the bar but could not see what was going on in the main dining room.

We finally had a break and went back to the bar and Ivy's brother came to me and pointed out a fellow sitting at the bar and said that he had insulted Beezie. Then the three girls said that they were sitting at the bar when this guy comes in and started asking the barman, who are these bitches, get them out of here, they stink.

So I went to the bar and asked this jerk what was the idea of insulting my wife and the girls that were with her? He started to puff up and asked me who the hell I was. I swung a right to his chin and that knocked him off of his stool. Cosey was standing near and the blow glanced and caughted him on the jaw but it didn't hurt him.
